title: Sublimit types and fields
text:
Sublimit types and fields

Importance of understanding how to specify limits and deductibles for sublimits in
 
Touchstone
.

It is also important to understand the criteria for specifying fields and which
 combinations of limit and deductible types are valid for sublimits.

In 
Touchstone
, you specify sublimit terms on the
 
Layers
 tab.
